name: github-token-settings
title: github-token-settings
description: github-token's section of the Settings dialog: The project's GitHub access (`github`) from a fine-grained token you made, the GITHUB_TOKEN secret, and the repository, a setting changed in the dashboard's Settings → GitHub: for a project run from the CLI or on a server. Its settings come with the component (pikit add github-token), stored by settings-store.
